abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

user.title: Set up WLED Backup Service
user.description: Manage scheduled backups, restore operations, and retention for WLED devices that are already configured in Home Assistant.

data_description.schedule_enabled: Turn scheduled backups on or off without removing the integration.
data_description.interval: How often the scheduled backup cycle should run.
data_description.interval_unit: Choose whether the interval is measured in minutes, hours, or days.
data_description.daily_time: Used when the schedule is exactly every 1 day. Multi-day schedules continue to use interval timing.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Choose where validated backup directories are stored. `/backup` is Home Assistant's backup-storage mount.

data_description.storage_root: Home Assistant storage root to use.
data_description.subdir: Relative folder path under the selected storage root. Nested folders are allowed, but absolute paths and traversal are blocked.

contents.title: Contents
contents.description: Choose which WLED artifacts each backup should include.

data_description.include_presets: Include `presets.json` in each backup when available.
data_description.include_state: Include the current on/off, brightness, and segment state snapshot.
data_description.create_archive: Reserved for future archive export support. Backups are currently stored as validated directories.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: Control how many backups are kept per device and how old they may become before pruning.

data_description.retention_count: Keep this many most recent backups per device. Set to 0 to disable count-based pruning.
data_description.retention_days: Delete backups older than this number of days after the count policy is applied. Set to 0 to disable age-based pruning.

behavior.title: Restore behavior
behavior.description: Configure safety checks for restore operations. Restoring can overwrite device settings, change connectivity, and optionally reboot the device.

data.backup_before_restore: Create a safety backup before restore

data_description.backup_before_restore: Create a fresh rollback point before any restore writes are applied.
data_description.verify_after_restore: Re-read device data after restore and report mismatches as warnings or failures.
data_description.reboot_after_restore: Allow restore to reboot the device after applying configuration changes.

error.invalid_interval: Enter an interval greater than zero.
error.invalid_subdir: Enter a safe relative backup path without absolute segments or traversal.
error.invalid_retention_count: Enter a retention count of 0 or greater.
error.invalid_retention_days: Enter a retention age in days of 0 or greater.

backup.name: Backup selected WLED devices
backup.description: Create a validated backup for the selected WLED device or devices.

include_state.name: Include current state
include_state.description: Include the current state snapshot in the backup.

label.name: Label
label.description: Reserved for future labeling support. It currently does not change the stored backup.

backup_all.name: Backup all discovered WLED devices
backup_all.description: Create validated backups for every discovered WLED device.

include_state.name: Include current state
include_state.description: Include the current state snapshot in every backup.

restore.name: Restore a WLED backup
restore.description: Destructive: overwrite selected backup data onto the targeted WLED device. This can change connectivity settings and may reboot the device.

backup_id.name: Backup ID
backup_id.description: Opaque backup identifier returned by `list_backups` or a previous backup response.

backup_before_restore.name: Create safety backup first
backup_before_restore.description: Create a fresh rollback backup before restore begins.

restore_config.name: Restore configuration
restore_config.description: Apply the stored `cfg.json` configuration to the device.

restore_presets.name: Restore presets
restore_presets.description: Apply the stored `presets.json` file when preset upload is supported and verified.

verify_after_restore.name: Verify after restore
verify_after_restore.description: Read the device again after restore and report mismatches.

reboot_after_restore.name: Reboot after restore
reboot_after_restore.description: Allow restore to reboot the device after applying configuration changes.

list_backups.name: List backups
list_backups.description: Return metadata for stored backups, optionally filtered by WLED target device.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of backups to return after sorting newest first.

delete_backup.name: Delete a backup
delete_backup.description: Delete a stored backup by its backup ID.

backup_id.name: Backup ID
backup_id.description: Opaque backup identifier returned by `list_backups` or a previous backup response.

prune.name: Prune backups
prune.description: Apply the configured retention policy to all backups or to the selected WLED devices.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Report which backups would be deleted without deleting them.

discover.name: Discover WLED devices
discover.description: Return the WLED devices currently available through Home Assistant's native WLED integration.

config_entry_not_loaded.message: No WLED Backup Service config entry is currently loaded.

config_entry_not_ready.message: WLED Backup Service is not ready yet. Load the config entry first.

target_required.message: This action requires at least one WLED device target.

restore_requires_single_device.message: Restore requires exactly one WLED target device.

restore_not_available.message: Restore is not available until the restore engine is implemented.

invalid_device_target.message: Device target {target} is not a Home Assistant WLED device.

unresolved_device_target.message: WLED device target {target} could not be resolved for backup.
